projects.title: Lunch Box
projects.summary: A team-based graded Java console application for managing lunch-box orders. It supports role-based accounts for customers, vendors, and administrators; menu and item management; ordering and payments; school and vendor records; and inventory data stored in a MySQL/MariaDB database.

projects.title: AI-Gen Image Community Event
projects.summary: Created for the Garena Hackathon: Digitalised Entertainment. Our product brings the community together to create an AI-generated emote for the event, with participants split into teams that each control a different part of the emote.

projects.title: Telegram Reminder Bot (WIP)
projects.summary: A Telegram bot that lets users set reminders and sends messages at the scheduled time. It also includes a built-in snooze feature and syncs with Google Calendar.
